# Professional Placement

> A staffing agency serving the Phoenix Metro area since 1955, connecting employers with qualified candidates through temporary and direct-hire placement services.

Professional Placement (also known as Pro-Tem Service) is an established recruitment firm based in Tempe, Arizona, specializing in staffing solutions for businesses throughout the Phoenix metropolitan region including Scottsdale and surrounding areas. The company provides both temporary staffing and permanent placement services to employers while offering career opportunities to job seekers.
